title: 100K context windows
before: Production context windows were 4K to 8K tokens, occasionally 32K.
problem: Anything book-length had to be chunked and retrieved rather than read.
breakthrough: A deployed 100,000-token window, enough for a novel or a large codebase in one prompt.
why: It opened the long-context era in products and began the running argument about retrieval versus a bigger window.
next: Gemini 1.5's million tokens, and the long-context race through 2026.
inherits: The expectation that a model can read a whole document.
